native_mechanisms: One crease per mark, each crease's angle set jointly by the mark and the immediately preceding crease (strict in-order chained state).
Every crease tested simultaneously against all four wire-bird beaks, refolded a half-shell tighter until all four agree.
The whole folded wad thinned at the water's edge into one small dense corner, with every scrap, spare sheet and failed reading discarded so nothing but the coin survives.
core_technique: Single-pass byte-at-a-time chained rotate-add/xor-multiply mixer (rotation count driven by popcount of the byte) feeding four parallel accumulators, closed with a Murmur3-style fmix64 finalizer — i.e. FNV/xxHash-style multiply-xor-shift accumulation, with the four-beak agreement test inert (the all-nonzero check essentially never fails) and the 'discard' step a no-op wipe of dead locals.
